summary: Perpetuals.com Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, providing notice of its Eighth Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders. The meeting is a routine annual event scheduled for July 24, 2026 in Tokyo, covering standard items such as the business report, approval of financial statements for the fiscal year ended April 30, 2026, and election of directors. The filing includes the meeting notice and proxy card as exhibits, furnished but not filed under the Exchange Act. No special-situation event—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other—is disclosed. This is a routine foreign private issuer disclosure under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to an annual meeting notice.
